newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent higher.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent per lb firmer on Thursday, dealers said.

Trade buying is expected to buoy the benchmark October contract in the wake of Wednesday's technically strong close, but selling by the speculators could block a move over its upside target of 11.22 cents, they said.

Wednesday, the most-active October contract ended 0.05 cents higher at 11.11 cents, having ranged from 11.00 to 11.12 cents. Second-position March closed up 0.04 at 11.25 cents, and the rest of the board finished 0.04 to 0.08 cent firmer.
Only 10,642 lots were estimated to have changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were higher on Thursday in thin dealings dominated by the spreads. At 0842 EDT/1242 GMT, LIFFE spot August stood $1.40 higher at $320.60, while October was up 80 cents to $315.00.
